name: Agent Questions
description: Questions from an agent, one step at a time, with single or multiple choice, an Other answer and step pills, sliding sideways between steps.

props.name: questions
props.type: { id: string; title: ReactNode; help?: ReactNode; type: "single" | "multiple"; options: { id: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode }[]; allowOther?: boolean }[]
props.description: The steps in order. allowOther adds an Other row that opens a text field when chosen.

props.name: onComplete
props.type: (answers: Record<string, { selected: string[]; other?: string }>) => void
props.description: Called when Start is pressed on the last step, with the chosen option ids and any Other text for each question id.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button in the corner and is called when it is pressed.

props.name: otherPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the Other text field. Enter in the field moves to the next step.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Other section props are spread onto it.
